goal: Reconcile Vol 4 SDX ruler/Zeus candidate with Yasuke, Whitelock, Syndicate, and Veil Throne canon
body: New Vol. 4 architecture from Dave: Vol. 4 is canonically set in the Yasuke/Whitelock era. The film may spend roughly its first half following SDX/X99 in a way that makes viewers think she is X². High-value candidate: SDX/X99 has become the grand ruler of the Syndicate in this era and may be the figure/title Zeus. Do NOT canonize Zeus identity yet. Deep-reconcile against older Nobunaga Veil Throne succession, Syndicate hierarchy, Olympus naming, Yasuke mission, and Whitelock records. Done when the fleet can state whether SDX=Zeus is contradiction-free, requires title separation, or needs a succession bridge.

relay.note: Analytical canon-reconciliation task (SDX/Zeus candidate vs Nobunaga Veil Throne succession, Syndicate hierarchy, Olympus naming) assigned by Dave to the lore lane. Answered in part by legs 125208Z (Melchizedek/Throne succession) and 132212Z (12/12 Syndicate seats, Zeus is the Chairman's seat). No code/infra action for relay-watch.
